name: Eventim US Event Listings
author: Eventim US

sections.description:
Eventim US Event Listings is a powerful WordPress plugin that enables event synchronization and integrates a modern, highly customizable event representation system. Powered by Eventim US, this plugin helps you showcase your events in various formats including list views, calendar views, and sliders.

Key Features

  • Multiple display options (List view, Calendar view, Slider)
  • Advanced event filtering
  • Category and tag management
  • Customizable design options
  • Event search functionality
  • Just announced events section
  • Responsive design

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.7 or higher
  • PHP 8.1 or higher
  • Advanced Custom Fields (Free or Pro version)

External services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its functionality:

See Tickets Core API

This plugin connects to the See Tickets Core API to obtain event data. This service is required for the plugin to function properly, as it retrieves event listings, event details, and related information for synchronization with your WordPress site.

What data is sent and when:
* API credentials (api-key and api-secret) are sent in HTTP request headers when fetching event data
* Client ID is included in the API request URL
* Data is sent during scheduled automatic imports (configurable interval) and when manually triggering the import via the plugin’s cron endpoint

Service provider: Eventim US / See Tickets USA
API endpoint: https://prod-seetickets-core.seeticketsusa.us/api/v2/client/{clientId}/event?pastHours=2160

Google Fonts

This plugin loads the Roboto font family from Google Fonts to provide consistent typography for the plugin’s user interface elements.

What data is sent and when:
* No user data is sent to Google Fonts
* The font stylesheet is loaded from Google’s CDN when pages containing plugin shortcodes are displayed
* Standard web requests (including IP address) are made to Google’s servers as part of loading the font stylesheet

Service provider: Google LLC
Service URL: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;700&display=swap
Terms of service: https://developers.google.com/fonts/faq
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/eventim-us-event-listings directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Install and activate Advanced Custom Fields plugin (required dependency).
  4. Use the Settings->See Tickets screen to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any other plugins?

Yes, this plugin requires Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) either the free or pro version.

Can I customize the appearance of the events?

Yes, the plugin provides extensive customization options including colors, layouts, and display styles.
